root_personal_verdict: Reserved to the philosophical reassessment; this is source reconstruction and bridge diagnosis.

premises.claim: Every actual agent needs power to act.

P2 is composite: P2a original power/will are intrinsic and not efficiently received; P2b full productive completion is not obtained from a rival’s contribution or leave. The source argues for P2b, not merely P2a, using necessary intrinsic perfection and efficacy-as-perfection. A model preserving only P2a does not preserve the full intended premise.
Realized productive efficacy is a perfection; dependence on another’s action for that efficacy is dependence for a perfection, incompatible with being necessary-by-itself.
premises.role: Substantive metaphysical strengthening of P2; its effect-condition to intrinsic-completion transfer remains the precise appraisal issue.

premises.claim: No priority-efficient circular derivation, including a part or condition of a productive cause; no regress of original efficient sources. Concomitance is separately allowed.
No two distinct agents each actually produce the same numerical effect wholly alone; sole entire production excludes any actual coproductor.
For equal lords, each can produce the same target effects as the other, and the requisite original power must persist in mutual presence.
Complete power together with complete determining will entails the exactly specified effect; unwilled intrinsic possibilities remain within power.
A possible, nonnecessary coalescence needs an efficient producer; in the proposed ultimate pair there is no independent third producer.
Any cross-domain coalescence by one lord changes what the other determines and thereby influences the latter’s determining power/will; with consent it is assistance, without consent restriction.
Necessary concord of two original wills/actions makes each a partial productive condition of the other, unless a third produces their concurrence; either defeats original independence.
From inability of two whole-alone actual productions, concurrent unrestricted equally-targeted original powers are excluded.
Actual creation is causally/materially interconnected, including generation, air/water/soil, solar and terrestrial interactions.
Plural original makers would have separate noninteracting creative domains; O1 excludes that partition of the actual world.
Unequal alleged lords imply superior over inferior; the inferior requires aid or noninterference and is not an original lord.
Possible concentration of two powers in one bearer; applicability to each existing partner and self-sufficiency consequence remain explicit steps.
premises.role: Source-explicit argued bridge; philosophical warrant assessed separately.

premises.claim: Complete power plus complete will entails exclusive actual production, not only outcome truth.
premises.role: Source-explicit argued bridge; philosophical warrant assessed separately.

bridges.B1: Output-coalescence to determining source power/will influence
bridges.B2: Necessary concord to reciprocal productive conditioning or third producer
bridges.B3: No duplicate actual sole production to no simultaneous unrestricted equal target-powers
bridges.P2b/M1: Need for another’s contribution to an effect is received productive perfection, not mere external concomitance

premise_quantifiers.actual_world: Actual created things and occurrences, not all relations called SourceMode.
premise_quantifiers.equal_case: Every effect in either equal maker’s target-power domain is in the other’s corresponding domain; not a mere existential ability.
premise_quantifiers.determination: For a specified target e: complete will(A,e) and complete power(A,e) entail e; distinguishes mere power from actuality.
premise_quantifiers.nonduplication: For any one numerical e, not two distinct actual whole-alone producers of e.
premise_quantifiers.conditionality: A condition of an effect, of the producer’s intrinsic capacity, and of complete exercise are separately typed.
premise_quantifiers.common_creator: One original Creator of the connected created field; complete cosmological reach uses the asserted interconnectedness of all creation, not merely nonisolated nodes.

control_status.full_premise_countermodel: None produced or verified in this assessment. Refer MODEL_AUDIT.md for independent model audit.
control_status.thin_models: Harmony graphs, uncaused partial powers, noncausal ground, disconnected-domain proposals do not automatically preserve the intended P2b/P5/P6.
control_status.no_circular_success_claim: Failure of current countermodels does not by itself prove M1/B1/B2/B3; stronger premise warrant remains separate from conditional validity.

fixed_background: Preserve actual determining will, complete productive state, target numerical effect and causal contribution. Unchanged standing capacities alone are insufficient.
countermodel_test_scope: When M1, B5_TRANSFER, B6_EXCLUSIVE_COMPLETION or another inference is offered to establish P2b, P2b is downstream of that inference. Denying P2b alone does not disqualify a countermodel to its derivation; preservation of every independently retained upstream premise is required. The complete intended source package and the upstream test package must not be conflated.
